artworks.title: Plate Number 120. Descending an incline with a bucket of water in right hand
artworks.medium: collotype
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, 1887)
artworks.description: The image shows a sequence of photographic frames displaying a nude person walking across a platform. The person is captured in profile in the top row and from the back in the bottom row. Their hair is styled upward and they are holding a metal bucket in their right hand. The platform includes steps and seems to be used for motion studies. The top row has a dark-toned grid background, while the bottom row shows an outdoor scene with trees and fencing. The frames document the person's movement across the platform.

artworks.title: Two Women in the Room (Zwei Frauen im Raum)
artworks.medium: brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: There are two people in the image, closely positioned. The person on the left is seated with their back to the viewer, displaying their bare back and long hair cascading down. The individual on the right is partially turned towards the first person, in a reclined position and wearing a loose-fitting garment. The scene is depicted in monochrome with bold, expressive strokes. The background is abstract with textured patterns and strokes creating an atmospheric setting.

artworks.title: Cauchemar (Nightmare)
artworks.medium: softground etching and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large amphibian-like creature and snakes above a face. The drawing shows a massive creature resembling a toad perched on a human-like head with a surprised or fearful expression. The face is surrounded by serpents or snake-like forms. The background features sharp triangular shapes, creating a dynamic atmosphere. The detailed linework and shading give depth and texture to the figures, evoking a sense of unease and mystery.

artworks.title: The Finding of Moses
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group gathered in an outdoor setting. The artwork depicts figures in a natural environment under a large bending tree. A mountainous landscape is visible in the distance. The figures wear flowing garments and display expressions and gestures. The scene is detailed with a cloudy sky in the background.

artworks.title: Jerusalem. Épée de Godefroy de Bouillon (Jerusalem. The Sword of Godfroy of Bouillon)
artworks.medium: salted paper print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro, in Honor of the 25th Anniversary of Photography at the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a sword with its sheath, a pair of spurs, and a decorative cross on a chain against a plain background. The color palette is monochrome in sepia tones. The sword is positioned vertically in the center, with the sheath slung diagonally across it and a piece of cloth hanging from it. To the left of the sword, the spurs are displayed, and above the sword's hilt, the decorative cross hangs from the chain.

artworks.title: Kees van Oeveren
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait engraving with a bust-length figure in an oval frame. The figure is a man facing slightly to his right, wearing a cap and draped in a cloak. The frame is decorated with a monkey, an owl, a cat, and two cherub-like figures holding a smaller oval frame with the image of a jester. Intricate engravings and inscriptions fill the background.

artworks.title: Death with Worldly Vanities
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund

artworks.title: Broadhead’s Creek, Delaware Water Gap
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John P. Coll, in memory of Margaret Canaga Coll and John Owen Reilly Coll, 2016
artworks.description: The image shows a natural setting by a stream, with trees covering the horizon. The water flows over a dam made of logs and branches, creating a smooth effect. The color palette is monochromatic, with sepia tones emphasizing the landscape's details. Light and shadow play on the rocky streambed and foliage, creating a serene yet dynamic scene.

artworks.title: The Pool, Franconia Mountains, New Hampshire
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from W. Bruce and Delaney H. Lundberg
artworks.description: The image shows a woodland scene with a waterfall, surrounded by trees and rocks. The waterfall flows over rocks, creating a sense of motion. The color palette is muted with sepia tones. The composition features a balance between rocks, trees, and the flowing water.

artworks.title: Saint Joachim and the Infant Virgin Mary
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of James A. Bergquist, in honor of Andrew Cliffe Robison
artworks.description: The image features an engraving showing two figures, an elder man and a child, depicted from the waist up. The elder man is seated, with his body turned slightly toward the child, holding the child's arm and gesturing with his right hand. He has a prominent beard and wavy hair, with a serene facial expression focused upwards. The child, positioned slightly in front of the man, is looking ahead with a gentle expression, hands clasped together. The child's hair is short and smooth. Both figures are draped in robes with visible folds. Radiant halos surround each head. The background consists of a finely hatched pattern, typical of engraving techniques. The engraving includes a decorative border and text below the image.

artworks.title: Saint Joseph and the Infant Jesus
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of James A. Bergquist, in honor of Andrew Cliffe Robison
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man seated with a baby in his arms. The man's head is tilted upward, and he has thick, wavy hair and a full beard. He is draped in a cloth that exposes his chest, with hands placed over his heart. The baby is wrapped in a cloth and lies across the man's lap. The background has a textured pattern. The man is surrounded by a radiant halo effect. There are no visible objects held. At the bottom of the image, there is a caption in Latin.

artworks.title: The Virgin
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of James A. Bergquist, in honor of Andrew Cliffe Robison
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in a three-quarter view, displaying her upper body from the waist up. She is positioned with her head tilted slightly upwards and to her left, her eyes gazing in the same direction, and her hands are gently crossed over her chest. The woman's facial features are soft and delicate, with a serene expression; she has a slender face and long hair flowing over her shoulders. She is dressed in a flowing robe with intricate lines depicting the fabric's folds. The background is a simple, lightly textured pattern, without any additional objects or jewelry present.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of James A. Bergquist, in honor of Andrew Cliffe Robison
artworks.description: The image shows the upper bodies of a woman and a child. The woman is seated, holding the child standing on her lap. The woman has smooth, wavy hair and classical facial features. She is wearing draped clothing. The child has curly hair and a serene expression, with a halo around his head. The child appears naked and is being supported by the woman's arms. In the background, there is a textured landscape with trees on the left and a distant mountainous horizon on the right.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Sleeping Child
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of James A. Bergquist, in honor of Andrew Cliffe Robison
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a seated woman holding a sleeping infant. The woman's head is slightly bowed, and her gaze is directed downward with her eyes closed. She has long hair that is covered with a light veil or cloth, falling gently around her face and shoulders. Her face is serene and finely-featured. She is dressed in flowing garments, consisting of layers of cloth that drape over her shoulders and arms. In her left hand, she gently supports the child, while her right hand rests on her chest. The infant rests peacefully on her lap, uncovered except for a simple cloth around the waist, with one arm behind its head in a relaxed posture. There is no jewelry visible on the woman or child. The background consists of a shaded area with a subtle texture, providing a simple and unobtrusive backdrop that emphasizes the figures. There is a caption at the bottom of the image, which reads "QVEM GENVIT ADORAVIT."

artworks.title: The Incredulity of Saint Thomas
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of James A. Bergquist, in honor of Andrew Cliffe Robison
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals from approximately the knees up, with one figure displaying more of his upper body. In the foreground, a central male figure is bent forward and touching the chest of another male figure on the right, who stands with his body exposed from the waist up, draped modestly in a cloth. This second figure, positioned in three-quarter view, has medium-length curly hair and a serene expression on his face, with a light radiating around his head. The other men surrounding them are dressed in long, flowing robes and have beards, and they are watching the interaction intently. The background features a simple architectural setup with a column on the left, suggesting an indoor setting. No jewelry or additional objects are prominently featured.

artworks.title: Bacchus Seated on a Barrel between Amor and Music
artworks.artist: Jan Sadeler I, after Joos van Winghe
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image presents three figures in the foreground, each depicted from head to toe. The central figure is seated with legs apart on a wooden structure. They have distinct facial features, a confident expression, and wear leaves in their hair. The central figure's clothing is minimal, with fabric draped over one shoulder, while holding a drinking vessel. To the left, another figure is seated, leaning on the structure with one leg bent. This figure has elaborate hair adorned with leaves and flowers, and wears a loosely draped garment while holding an object resembling a horn. To the right, a cherubic figure, with wings, sits partially reclining, holding a torch in one hand and an arrow in the other, draped in a flowing garment. The background features lush trees, grapevines, and swirling clouds in the sky. The scene is framed by intricate detailing.

artworks.title: Rovine cagionate in Tivoli, dall'escrescenza dell'Aniene (Tivoli Damaged by the Flood of the River Aniene)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a river valley with a village on a rocky hillside. The horizon is high, matching the distant mountains. There are buildings, including a bell tower, in the village. The artwork is an etching with fine lines creating textures and shadows. The color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of gray and black. In the foreground, there are cliffs, water, and trees. The village stretches across the ridges, set against undulating landscape and clouds.

artworks.title: Le Défenseur (Counsel for the Defense)
artworks.medium: pen and black ink, charcoal, crayon, and watercolor on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (William A. Clark Collection, 1926)
artworks.description: This painting shows two people from about the waist up. The person on the left is leaning forward from behind a ledge, both of their arms extended to the right. They have large eyes dripping with tears, a bulbous nose, sagging cheeks, and sparse hair that appears to be graying. They are wearing a dark robe that covers most of their body, with a white cravat visible at their neck. Beside them, resting on the ledge to the left, is a black hat and a stack of books or papers. The person on the right is seated next to the ledge with their hands folded in their lap, facing forward. They have a small, pointed nose and a subtle smile, and they have curly brown hair styled atop their head. They wear a light-colored dress with puffed sleeves and a high collar with a bow. Both of these people have pale skin. Behind them are numerous people sitting in rows in the background. The setting features an arch and paneling, with a ray of light casting diagonally across the space, illuminating the seated person.

artworks.title: Two Women
artworks.medium: pastel over watercolor and charcoal on tan laid paper, mounted to board
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (William A. Clark Collection, 1926)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting two women standing next to each other in different positions. The woman on the left is standing upright and looking to the left with her hands behind her back, while the one on the right is bending slightly forward, looking at a small orange flower she holds in her hand. The women look almost identical, with pale skin and brown hair styled in updos, and they both wear pink dresses with blue bodices and collars. The background is a room with walls in shades of brown, orange and yellow ochre. To the right of the women, there are two blue vases on a white table or mantle, with a golden object between them, perhaps a clock. In the bottom left corner is a large red-orange armchair with its back to us. A similar armchair is across from it, behind the women.

artworks.title: Calling Home the Cows
artworks.medium: pastel and conté crayon on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (William A. Clark Collection, 1926)
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a pastoral scene with grazing cattle and a herder standing on a small mound. The man is facing left, holding a small horn up to his lips and blowing in to it. In the bottom left of the drawing, two of the cows are on a dirt path facing us, one white and one brown. They appear to have small silver bells around their necks. The rest of the cows are behind the small mound. Above the brown dirt path and scrubby green plants, the sky is a blend of light peach and pink, with some dark purple clouds made of thin crosshatching lines.

artworks.title: Shepherd Returning with His Flock
artworks.medium: conté crayon and pastel
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (William A. Clark Collection, 1926)

artworks.title: Falling Leaves
artworks.medium: pastel and conté crayon on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (William A. Clark Collection, 1926)
artworks.description: This drawing shows a pastoral scene. Closest to us is a hill with some small, bare trees on the right. Some leaves fall from the branches, drifting towards the ground. A person stands among these trees with their back to us, looking out at the valley in the distance below. On the right, sheep seem to graze along this hill. The wide valley stretches away towards the horizon in shades of green and tan, and the sky above is pale orange with some white and pale-blue clouds.

artworks.title: The Church of San Giorgio Maggiore
artworks.medium: pastel and conté crayon on brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of James Parmelee, 1941)

artworks.title: Male Torso with Pole
artworks.medium: charcoal and chalk on grey laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a male figure. The person is facing slightly to the right with arms raised above the head, holding onto a long object. The facial features are detailed with strong cheekbones and a focused expression, while the hair is short. The figure is bare-chested, showing muscular definition, with no visible clothing or accessories. The drawing is on light-colored paper with a neutral background.
